title: Define Orbit Alpha closure
content: We need an Alpha that small users can try, with reviewable Knowledge, confirmed Memory, and no hidden external actions.

summary: Outlined four Alpha hardening goals and acceptance commands.

content.text: Goal 4 should add Knowledge review actions, Memory governance, Recommendation actions, and audit logs.

title: Memory candidates require confirmed Knowledge
content: Pipeline should not create Memory from draft or rejected Knowledge. Confirmation creates candidates and writes audit logs.
